items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: he offered me a job. So when I got discharged, I went to Los Angeles, come back up here and work a while.

ctx.x: Can you tell about your first experiences when you came up here and played at the Barbary?
About stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like stuff

Matt Wilkerson, he run what they call a cavalry over there, trying to think, Bancroft, that was the name of it. And that was the only two colored spots they had around here in San Francisco. And all the rest of them were white places. And during that time, why local Sikhs were so strong, they said all the territory belongs to them and it was frightening the proprietors from hiring colored musicians.
